color.description: A CSS hex color, or one of the document theme's colors: primary (text), accent, or tertiary (faded text).

points.description: Flattened vertices as x, y pairs in drawing space. The last joins back to the first.

fill.description: A filled polygon, painted with the nonzero rule: the region a stroke encloses.

fills.description: Painted in order, beneath the strokes.

main.description: Freehand ink strokes. The view box is the area of drawing space the block shows, scaled to the block's width; strokes may reach past it.

size.description: The stroke's base diameter in drawing space.

color.description: A CSS hex color, or one of the document theme's colors: primary (text), accent, or tertiary (faded text).

points.description: Flattened input points as x, y, pressure triples: x and y in drawing space, pressure from 0 to 1000.

simulatePressure.description: The input had no real pressure (a mouse or finger); derive it from the stroke's speed instead.

stroke.description: One pen stroke, drawn in order, rendered as a variable-width outline of its input points (as perfect-freehand does).
